localContext: Shreveport and Bossier City sit on the Haynesville Shale, one of the largest natural gas plays in the country, so pipeline construction, gathering lines, compressor stations and treating plants supply much of the inspection work. Benteler Steel/Tube runs a tube mill at the Port of Caddo-Bossier, Calumet operates a specialty refinery in Shreveport, and Barksdale Air Force Base anchors military aviation across the river. The work runs to API 1104, ASME B31.8, ASME pressure equipment codes and product specifications, so VT, UT and RT are the core skills.
certPathwayNote: Employers in Caddo and Bossier parishes certify their own technicians under written practices built on ASNT SNT-TC-1A, with a Level III signing off examinations and vision checks. Pipeline owners, mill customers and refinery inspection programs add their own acceptance criteria and audit expectations. Air Force aircraft inspection follows military technical orders. ASNT central certification is the alternative for individuals who want a portable credential.
